The <b>Maiden's Soul</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i> [[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The <b>Maiden's Soul</b> can be given to the [[Caretaker]] in [[Songclave]] along with the [[Hermit's Soul]], [[Seeker's Soul]], and [[Snare Setter]] to complete the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wish.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sherma 07.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Caretaker 01.png!Caretaker in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
After accepting the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must travel to [[Bone Bottom]] and speak with the [[Chapel Maid]] who will give her the Maiden's Soul.
